name: print-social-flyer-vr-glitch-cyan-purple-outline-type
title: VR flyer with glitch photo effect and outline typography
whatItIs: A square tech flyer on a purple/cyan split background, featuring a VR-headset photo with a red/cyan RGB glitch offset effect and a large outline-only 'TECH' wordmark.
whatItMeans: A glitch/chromatic-aberration effect on the photo signals 'digital/VR' more viscerally than a clean photo would, while the outline-only headline keeps the layout from feeling cluttered.
techniques: offset red and cyan color channels on a photo for a glitch/VR distortion effect
render a large headline in outline-only type so it reads as bold without adding visual weight
split the background into two flat color fields to separate photo and text zones

vocabulary.definition: an intentional offsetting of color channels to simulate digital distortion or a glitch
